# 2 Chronicles 14 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 14 (15 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.5
- **EMET:** "And-he-removed from-all cities-of Judah the-high-places and-the-incense-altars and-the-kingdom was-quiet before-him."
- **LOGOS:** "He also took out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the incense altars. And the kingdom had rest under him."
- **PNEUMA:** "He removed the high places and incense altars from every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.6
- **EMET:** "And-he-built cities-of fortification in-Judah for quiet was the-land and-none with-him war in-the-years these for gave-rest to-him YHWH."

- **PNEUMA:** "He built fortified cities in Judah since the country was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, because the LORD gave him rest."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
